profile.headline: Senior Software Developer & Team Lead at University of Connecticut
profile.summary:
Business professional and software developer with strong technical and business acumen. Passionate and driven to use technology to help deliver solutions and value to businesses and people. Always looking to stay up to date on the latest technologies and utilize different types of training to keep ahead of the curve and implement modern, technical solutions across different businesses and industries. Have a strong and innate ability to be able to analyze a process, provide suggestions for improvement, and implement key improvements to help increase efficiency and overall organization and team effectiveness.

Specialties: C#, .NET, ASP.NET, MVC, Web Forms, web applications, IIS, SQL, TFS, GIT, Visual Studio, Xamarin, mobile development, automated testing, NUnit, Selenium, Salesforce, APEX, Process Management

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
- Responsible for system architecture, development, project planning and timelines, technical staff onboarding, and management of a team of seven.
- Active contributor to several custom software applications, business intelligence reporting, and overall custom software application needs for the whole college; spanning administrative and research needs.
- Implement several large, loosely coupled modules and shared features across applications for notifications, document management, data management, and reporting. Introduce use of nuget packages to standardize and share common code across applications. Implement Domain Driven Design for complex business logic.
- Engineered an enterprise messaging layer using an enterprise service bus (NServiceBus) to facilitate asynchronous communication and protocol transformation across heterogeneous systems. Implemented robust error-handling, retry logic, and message routing, resulting in a 99.9% success rate for cross-departmental data synchronization.
- Rolled out AI agent usage into development workflow across the team 
- Modernized CI/CD pipeline and overall ALM tooling to streamline development process, deployment, testing
- Developed robust automated testing suite, bringing total automated tests from zero to over 2000

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented new business process for backlog management and hired technical resources 
- Automated UI testing w/Selenium web driver
- Introduced parallel, automated integration & unit testing w/NUnit, FluentAssertions, NBuilder

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Key contributor on a small team of full stack web developers responsible for three internal ASP.NET MVC web applications for financial management, budgeting, staffing planning & projections, grants management, reporting, and more. Technologies and tools include C#, T-SQL, LINQ, Entity Framework, HTML, CSS, JQuery, Knockout JS, SQL Server, TFS.
- Involved in all phases of the SDLC, including interfacing with business users to gather information and requirements, and delivering them as new, fully functional modules within the systems, and performing both manual and automated testing.
- Suggested and implemented several improvements to the development process including improved source code branch management, one click deployments to all environments, automatic database migrations, integration of modern Knockout JS front end framework on legacy and new pages, refactoring of server side code to follow SOLID principles, design best practices, and allow for better automated unit testing.
- Automated Unit and Integration testing using NUnit 3, Moq, Faker.NET, and Fluent Assertions.
- Automated UI testing using Selenium web driver, including being responsible for managing and reviewing work of QA tester and automation engineer.
- Responsible for management, maintenance, and creation of new college wide reports written in FOCUS and developed on WEB FOCUS, the central business intelligence and analytics platform.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: - Worked on desktop and web based loan management product used for loan origination, servicing, and reporting. Responsible for adding enhancements to newer .NET systems as well as a legacy desktop application written in PowerFlex. Technologies included VB.NET, ASP.NET Web Forms, T-SQL, Entity Framework, LINQ, Telerik UI for WinForms, and PowerFlex.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for the architecture and development of multi-tier and multi-platform application that involved a web application, mobile applications, hardware devices in the field, and Salesforce that all integrated and worked with the same data; supporting multiple business process flows across several devices. Making use of an API based Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), as well as multiple design patterns including MVVM, Repository, and Unit of Work. Technologies utilized included ASP.NET, Xamarin, C#, MVC, WebAPI REST services with JSON, Dependency Injection (Autofac), Automapper , Entity Framework (Code First), SQL Server, Salesforce, OWIN Middleware, Microsoft Identity, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), JQuery, HTML, and CSS.
- Development and custom implementations of Sitefinity, Salesforce, and pure ASP.NET MVC enterprise level websites across several industries and companies. Technologies and tools used include C#,  HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery, SQL, SQL Server, Visual Studio, TFS, WebAPI, Web Services (SOAP & REST).
- Development of multiple cross platform, mobile applications for companies in the financial and sorority industries, using Xamarin and C# for both Android and iOS.

positions.title: Software Developer / Quality Assurance Analyst II
positions.description:
- Contributed to development of Microsoft ASP.NET "greenfield" web application using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, SQL, JQuery, Kendo UI, HTML, & CSS.
- Successfully implemented open source Umbraco CMS as the back end management system for the help files for use in the help center of the main system, as well as the help center itself.
- Worked as part of the implementation team for product launch and client on-boarding including build deployment, release management, data conversion, and application setup/configuration.
- Quality Assurance lead that involved testing of an enterprise level web application for Housing Authorities across the country. Including functional testing, cross-browser testing, acceptance testing, regression testing, end to end testing, and monitoring of security and performance testing. Use of JIRA for test case and bug tracking, as well as TFS for build deployments.
- Responsible for procurement and RFP process for security vendor for web application and network testing.
- Coordination of security testing of the web application as well as additional project management tasks.
- Creation of fully functional system prototypes and product demos displayed to board members and end users using Axure prototyping software.
- Creation of business level specifications for integration of help system into the main application.
- Worked with both onshore and offshore teams.
